4346.body: Fixed in 2affeb90b. The read, duplicate check and save of an append now run inside `Entry.transaction` with `entry.lock!`, which also reloads the entry, so an edit committed in between (including one that locks the notes) is seen instead of overwritten. `entry.with_lock` isn't usable here: `Entry#transaction` is the delegated-type reader, so `with_lock` never yields. New test `append_transaction_notes builds on notes saved after the entry was loaded` fails without the fix.

4347.body: Fixed in 2f9cfd929. `Entry#rule_input_snapshot` is taken before the edit and `apply_immediate_rules_later(changed_from:)` only enqueues when the transaction's values or tags actually changed. A PATCH whose permitted params are empty therefore runs no rules. Test: `an update reduced to nothing by the account permission runs no immediate rules`.

Fixed in 2f9cfd929. `Rule#matching_scope(within_ids:)` adds the id restriction before a regex condition is resolved, and the runner passes `transaction_ids` there instead of filtering afterwards. Test: `matching_scope resolves a pattern only within the given transactions`.

Fixed in 2f9cfd929. The job now offers the toast only when a run already modified something; a run with AI actions that is still pending offers it from `RuleRun#complete_job!` once its last job finished and changed something (immediate runs only). Tests in `rule_run_test.rb`.

Fixed in 2f9cfd929 with one mechanism for every trigger: a snapshot of the entry, the transaction and its tag ids (read from the database) before the update, compared afterwards, so nested transaction changes and tag-only updates count and same-value updates don't. `@transaction` stays assigned for rendering. Test: `an API update that changes nothing runs no immediate rules`.
Fixed in 2f9cfd929, same snapshot comparison in `update`. Test: `an update that changes nothing runs no immediate rules`.

Fixed in 2f9cfd929. Tags are compared before and after, so re-sending the same set runs nothing; a real toggle still enqueues. Tests: `setting the same tags again runs no immediate rules`, `toggling a tag runs immediate rules`.

Fixed in 2f9cfd929. `Entry.bulk_update!` now yields each transaction entry whose values actually changed; the controller collects those from both partitions and passes only them. The returned count is unchanged. Test: `bulk update runs immediate rules only on transactions it changed`.

Fixed in 2f9cfd929 through the same `bulk_update!` block, so a transaction that already had the category is left out (both bulk categorize and assign_entry). Test: `create runs immediate rules only on transactions whose category changed`.
Fixed in 2f9cfd929, snapshot taken before `update!` and compared after, tags included. Test: `an update that changes nothing runs no immediate rules`.
